insight.headline: OrderCreate Mutation
insight.what_changed: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment. A trackingNumbers field has been added to OrderCreateFulfillmentInput, allowing multiple tracking numbers to be attached to a fulfillment when importing orders. This change is available in the GraphQL Admin API.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the orderCreate mutation to import orders should update their code to utilize the new trackingNumbers field. This field allows for multiple tracking numbers to be attached to a fulfillment, providing more flexibility and accuracy in order tracking. Developers should review their existing code and update it to take advantage of this new feature. The GraphQL Admin API should be used to access this new field.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will benefit from more accurate and detailed order tracking, allowing them to better manage their fulfillment operations. This change will also enable merchants to provide more detailed tracking information to their customers.
insight.why_it_matters: This change matters because it provides more flexibility and accuracy in order tracking, enabling merchants to better manage their fulfillment operations and provide more detailed tracking information to their customers. It also demonstrates Shopify's commitment to continually improving and expanding its APIs.

updates.title: @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.4
updates.summary: Hydrogen CLI now supports a new flag --javascript-origin to override the default dev origin. Local Hydrogen CLI discovery has also been fixed.

updates.title: @shopify/mini-oxygen@4.2.2
updates.summary: MiniOxygen now supports HTTP/2 requests in Vite request conversion.

updates.title: @shopify/hydrogen@2026.4.5
updates.summary: Customer account login recovery has been improved when switching browser contexts or opening multiple login tabs. OAuth state values now use cryptographically secure randomness.

updates.title: skeleton@2026.4.6
updates.summary: Newly scaffolded storefronts now recommend the Shopify AI Toolkit. Updated dependencies are also included.

updates.title: @shopify/create-hydrogen@5.0.39
updates.summary: The create-hydrogen package now recommends the Shopify AI Toolkit in newly scaffolded storefronts.

updates.title: Shop Campaigns performance data now available via ShopifyQL
updates.summary: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL using the shop_campaign_insights schema.
The CLI now serves UI extension source maps during app development.

updates.title: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes
updates.summary: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, including updating cart attributes and firing a new event when an attribute update is initiated.

updates.title: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is moving from reserved to committed
updates.summary: Inventory holds for draft orders, transfers, and shipments are being consolidated from reserved to committed.

updates.title: WebMCP support for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts
updates.summary: WebMCP tools are now exposed for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, allowing AI agents to interact with the storefront.

updates.title: Oxygen is now available on development stores
updates.summary: Oxygen is now available for development stores, allowing deployment of Hydrogen storefronts.

updates.title: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment
updates.summary: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment.

recap.headline: Hydrogen updates and new ShopifyQL schema for Shop Campaigns performance data

themes.title: Hydrogen Updates
themes.detail: Multiple Hydrogen-related packages received updates, including @shopify/cli-hydrogen, @shopify/mini-oxygen, @shopify/hydrogen, skeleton, and @shopify/create-hydrogen. These updates include new flags, improved local discovery, support for HTTP/2 requests, and enhanced security features like cryptographically secure randomness for OAuth state values.

themes.title: ShopifyQL and Analytics
themes.detail: The shop_campaign_insights schema is now available in ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query Shop Campaigns performance data on behalf of authorized merchants.

actions.text: Update Hydrogen projects to the latest versions of @shopify/cli-hydrogen, @shopify/mini-oxygen, @shopify/hydrogen, skeleton, and @shopify/create-hydrogen
